---
toc: false
page-layout: full
listing:
  - id: latest-news
    contents: news/*/index.qmd
    sort: "date desc"
    type: default
    max-items: 1
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script type="module">
        import { getCorePackages, getAtlasPackages } from './js/api.js';
        import { renderCorePackages } from './js/render.js';

        const coreContainer = document.getElementById('core-packages-grid');
        const atlasCount = document.getElementById('atlas-count');

        getCorePackages().then(pkgs => {
          coreContainer.classList.add('fade-in-up');
          renderCorePackages(pkgs, coreContainer);
        });
        getAtlasPackages().then(pkgs => { atlasCount.textContent = pkgs.length; });
      </script>
---

::: {.hero-preview}

::::: {.hero-code}
```r
library(ggseg)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  geom_brain(
    atlas = dk(),
    aes(fill = region),
    position = position_brain(hemi ~ view),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
:::::

::::: {.hero-result}
```{r}
#| label: hero-plot
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "2D brain atlas showing the Desikan-Killiany parcellation"
#| dev.args: { bg: "transparent" }
library(ggseg)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  geom_brain(
    atlas = dk(),
    aes(fill = region),
    position = position_brain(hemi ~ view),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
  )
```
:::::

::: {.content-section}
## Quick Install

```r
# Install from R-universe
install.packages(
 c("ggseg", "ggseg3d", "ggseg.extra"),
 repos = c(
   "https://ggseg.r-universe.dev",
   "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```
:::

::: {.content-section-alt}
## Core Packages {.section-header}

The ggsegverse provides tools for visualizing brain atlas data in R and Python.
Built on top of ggplot2 and Three.js.

::: {#core-packages-grid .package-grid}
